title: Parkour by JordanGbu
body:
# 🚀Features:
- 🏆 Dynamic Rank System (Grading): Automatically awards ranks (SS, S, A, B, C, D) based on the time difference compared to the parkour's World Record (#1).
- ✨ Holograms & Animations: Floating holograms for live timers (above the player's head), global leaderboards, and full support for dynamic animations (like %animation:rainbow-name%).
- 🎁 Smart Rewards: Configure console commands, player commands, and personalized custom messages. Rewards are automatically executed when a player completes the parkour for the very first time.
- 🗺️ Exploration Mode: Gamify your server by hiding parkours as "???" in the main menu until the player finds them in the world and steps on their start plate.
- 🌐 Multi-Language: Full support for English and Spanish (messages_en.yml / messages_es.yml), plus native extended support for MiniMessage formatting.

# 📜 Commands & Permissions:
## General Players
- /pk — Opens the public parkour list to check progress and play.
- /pk quit — Forces an exit from the current parkour session and restores your freedom.
- (No extra permissions required; enabled by default).

## Administrators (parkour.admin)
- /pka — Opens the general Control Panel to oversee and configure everything.
- /pka reload — Instantly reloads config.yml and translation files without restarting the server.
- parkour.bypass — Allows Admins/Builders to teleport, fly, and break blocks within the area of an active parkour without terminating their session.
  
# 🛠️Creating Your First Parkour
- Type /pka to open the Admin Menu.
- Click the Emerald (+ Create Parkour) located at the bottom.
- The menu will close. Type the public name for your new parkour in the chat.
- You will automatically enter Setup Mode, and your inventory will temporarily change.
- Physically place the provided plates in the world:
  1. Gold Plate (Start): Where players begin the parkour.
  2. BlackStone Plate(s) (Checkpoint): Along the path to divide the map into segments.
  3. Iron Plate (Finish): Where the parkour ends.
- Once the route is ready, click the green Save & Exit item in your inventory.

![Admin Menu](https://i.ibb.co/HL2QHr2T/Admin-GUI.gif)
